question.text: Per the exchange contract specifications for derivatives, the minimum value of a derivative contract (trading lot) at the time of its introduction must be not less than __________.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Series XII pages 203-204 and 207, the exchange contract specifications for futures and options state that the trading lot value at the time of introduction shall not be below Rs. 5 lakhs. The lot size is derived by dividing this minimum value by the underlying price. The Trap: Rs. 1 lakh and Rs. 2 lakhs are below the specified minimum. Rs. 10 lakhs is higher than the specified minimum. The figure to remember is Rs. 5 lakhs as stated in the exchange contract specifications. Note: The Rs. 5 lakh minimum is framed in the checked pages as an exchange contract specification at introduction, not as a separate SEBI-issued mandate.
